name: reserverail-hsk
description: USDC.e-backed stablecoin issuance and redemption on HSK Chain

scripts.build: pnpm typecheck && pnpm build:web && pnpm contracts:build
scripts.format: pnpm exec prettier --write apps/web && forge fmt --root contracts
scripts.format:check: pnpm exec prettier --check apps/web && forge fmt --root contracts --check
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
